en.title: Chrome Rain, Digital Testament
en.premise: In an era where flying ships dominate logistics, I am an information courier. One night, I stumble upon a piece of undeletable encrypted data—an archaic analog record known as "The Lost Letter." It contains the memories of a girl, secrets capable of shaking the foundations of the megacorps that rule the world. With the lasers of my pursuers searing my vision, I dive into the abyss of the circuitry to decode the truth.

zh.title: 铬之雨，电子遗言
zh.premise: 在飞船主宰物流的时代，我是一名情报运输员。某夜，我拾得了一份无法删除的加密数据——一份被称为《失落之信》的古老模拟格式记录。那是某个少女的记忆，足以撼动统治世界的巨型企业的根基。在追击者的激光灼烧视线的瞬间，为了解开真相，我潜入了回路的深渊。
